extension.summary: Optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins: art colours, soft art, album spines, queue reordering and a genre wheel.
extension.description: An optional helper for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Each skin turns on only the features it uses, and every skin works fully without it. The features: the colours of the focused and the playing album's art, with a soft, blurred copy of the art to light the screen; a coloured spine for every album in the music library; reordering of the Up next queue; the library's genres, styles and moods with album counts, ready to play as a shuffled mix. While a skin that uses none of them is active, the helper stays idle. Album colours, soft art and spines use the Python Imaging Library (script.module.pil), which Kodi installs with it.
extension.disclaimer: Made for KarmaMole's Kodi skins. Other skins can opt in; see the API notes in the source repository.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release as the shared KarmaMole Skin Helper (it was the Groove helper): art colours with soft art, album spines, Up next reordering, genre/style/mood wheel and true shuffle, each turned on per skin. Shuffled mixes are put in a random order by the helper, so Kodi's own shuffle setting is never changed.
